title: 第23章 小醮成焚心火第14章 再见师妹焚髓剑煞
content_zh:
腾蛇无足而飞，鼯鼠五技而穷。
只是略一思索，陆玄心中就有了决断。
当选杀伐！
他有玉碟古字，自然要精益求精。
心中既定，陆玄不再劳神思索，只是盘膝静心，静静等待天时。
不多时，夜色深沉，周天昏暗，茫茫山崖之中，一片寂静，醮室之中亦是只有陆玄自己的呼吸声。
静心吐纳，直到夜色极深。
突然间，陆玄睁眼，取出令牌，插在金炉槽中，口中默念“火”字。
“轰！”
霎时间，金炉微颤，勾动地火，赤色火焰自炉中喷涌，高达尺许。
若是胎息修士在此，当即就要大汗淋漓，毛发被燃。
这是二阶灵火，酉阳地火，虽不是什么世间神火，但胜在纯粹，最是适合熔炼灵物。
陆玄依旧盘膝，不曾动弹，只是静静看着酉阳地火喷涌而出。
“轰！！”
随着时间的推移，此火喷涌的高度反而下降，仅得半尺，但一片赤色，映得陆玄脸颊如火。
火涌半尺，赤色如阳，才是熔炼灵物的最佳时机。
陆玄抓住时机，伸手一挥，阳燧枝当即落在身前的酉阳地火之中。
“轰！”
霎时间，酉阳地火骤然喷涌，直冲天际，足有三尺高。
阳燧枝本是聚火之物，此刻撞上这酉阳地火，自然如同天雷勾动地火，火势大涨。

但陆玄却依旧不为所动，只是口鼻之间，有丝丝缕缕的“炁”流动而出。
这“炁”似有灵性，撞上眼前炙热的火焰，顿时凝聚成了一条鳞甲分明，栩栩如生的赤色小龙。
乾元六龙御天真经！
此经取自御六龙驾日，周天巡行之意，乃是凝聚真灵，搬运灵气之法。
故此，此经修行有异象。
周身灵炁，可凝赤龙，赤龙游动周天，搬运灵气，而后巡回归身，如驾日而归，令修士灵炁增长。
此刻，这赤龙就是陆玄运转真经的异象，这赤龙也当真可以搬运灵炁，融入他身。
只是此刻，陆玄要的不是搬运灵炁。
而是……御火炼物。
“我采集朝煌真炁，修乾元六龙御天真经，自然有御火控温之能……”
陆玄心中一动，赤龙游动，原本喷涌的酉阳地火顿时变得温顺，但火焰温度并未降低，反而更为炙热，甚至化为赤金之色，将阳燧枝死死的裹在其中。
这醮室勾连地火，灵火几乎可是说是源源不绝，只要操控得法，烧个百载都不成问题。
陆玄自然无需这般久。
只见随着时间的推移，阳燧枝那焦黑色的枝条似是承受不住高温，发出了崩裂之声。
“噼啪！”
阳燧枝一崩裂，内中就有流金状，似熔浆般的液体流出。
这浆液刚一流出，就有消散虚空，回归天地的趋势。
但同时，一股冥冥之念，亦随着此浆液的流出而浮现。
content_en:
The soaring snake has no legs and can fly, while the flying squirrel has no skills.
After just a brief thought, Lu Xuan made a decision in his heart.
Choose to kill!
He has the ancient calligraphy of Jade Disc, so he naturally has to strive for excellence.
Having made up his mind, Lu Xuan no longer bothered to think about it, but just crossed his legs and meditated, waiting for the right time.
Not long after, the night was dark, the sky was dark, and there was silence among the vast cliffs. The only sound in the altar room was Lu Xuan's own breathing.
Breathe calmly until the night is extremely dark.
Suddenly, Lu Xuan opened his eyes, took out the token, inserted it into the golden furnace slot, and silently recited the word "fire".
"Boom!"
In an instant, the golden furnace trembled slightly, igniting the ground fire, and red flames spurted out from the furnace, reaching a height of several feet.
If the fetal breath monk were here, he would be sweating profusely and his hair would be burned.
This is the second-level spiritual fire, Youyang Earth Fire. Although it is not a divine fire in the world, it is superior in purity and is most suitable for smelting spiritual objects.
Lu Xuan remained cross-legged and did not move, just quietly watching the fire from Youyang spurting out.
"Boom!!"
As time went by, the height of the fire spurt dropped to only half a foot, but it was so red that it made Lu Xuan's cheeks burn.
The fire surges half a foot and is as red as the sun, which is the best time to smelt spiritual objects.
Lu Xuan seized the opportunity and waved his hand, and the Yang Suizhi immediately fell into the Youyang Earth Fire in front of him.
"Boom!"
In an instant, Youyang's ground fire suddenly spewed out, reaching the sky, reaching a height of three feet.
The Yang Sui branch is originally a thing that gathers fire. When it hits the Youyang earth fire, it is naturally like a thunder from the sky stirring up the earth fire, and the fire increases greatly.
But Lu Xuan remained unmoved, but there were strands of "Qi" flowing out from between his mouth and nose.
This "qi" seemed to have spirituality. When it hit the hot flames in front of him, it suddenly condensed into a lifelike red dragon with distinct scales.
Qianyuan Six Dragons Royal Heaven Sutra!
This sutra is taken from the meaning of driving the six dragons on the sun and patrolling the sky. It is a method of condensing the true spirit and transporting the spiritual energy.
Therefore, there are visions in practicing this sutra.
The spiritual energy all over the body can be condensed into a red dragon. The red dragon swims around the sky, carrying spiritual energy, and then returns to the body as if riding the sun, making the monk's spiritual energy grow.
At this moment, this red dragon is the vision of Lu Xuan's revolving scripture. This red dragon can really transport spiritual energy and integrate it into his body.
It's just that at this moment, what Lu Xuan wants is not to transport spiritual energy.
But...fire-controlling objects.
"I collected the Chaohuang True Qi and cultivated the Qianyuan Six Dragons to Control the Heavenly Scripture. Naturally, I have the ability to control fire and temperature..."
Lu Xuan's heart moved, and the red dragon swam. The originally gushing Youyang Earth Fire suddenly became docile, but the temperature of the flame did not decrease, but became even hotter, and even turned into a red gold color, tightly wrapping the Yang Sui Branch in it.
This sacrificial ceremony room is connected to the earthly fire, and the spiritual fire is almost endless. As long as it is controlled properly, it will not be a problem to burn it for hundreds of years.
Lu Xuan naturally doesn't need to take so long.
As time went by, the charred black branches of Yangsuizhi seemed to be unable to withstand the high temperature and made a cracking sound.
"Crack!"
As soon as the Yangsui branch breaks, a golden, molten-like liquid flows out from inside.
As soon as this slurry flows out, it has the tendency to dissipate into the void and return to the heaven and earth.
But at the same time, a dark thought also emerged as the slurry flowed out.
